title: pairtime today --json
description: One local day's time for each project, as `pairtime today --json` prints it (docs/PLAN.md WP-CO0; DESIGN 3.8). The CLI reads it from the day's rollup the agent's scorer writes, days/YYYY-MM-DD.json (DESIGN 3.5), and display.shadow from config.toml. Seconds may be halves. you is your time: the credited seconds (SM 5.1), absent from every project while display.shadow is on, when the day is calibrating (DESIGN 6.7). agents is each agent's time on its own: the seconds its turns in the project ran that the project didn't credit, including seconds credited to another project (SM 5.3's agent_only_s; SM 6.3). other is the rest of the uncredited time by reason (SM 5.2), without X.agent_only and X.automated, which are the agent's time (approach-teen.md D5). While calibrating, a project shows the agent's time and other holds SM 4.2's loops alone, X.day_cap left out too, so the hidden credited total can't be worked out from the rest (D-shadow-scope; DESIGN 6.7 step 2; SM 7.5). Each words field is the text internal/coach/text gives the code; codes this build has no words for are left out. cmd/pairtime's tests check `pairtime today --json` against this file.

date.description: The local day, in the profile's time zone.

calibrating.description: display.shadow: while true, no project has you.

projects.description: Every project with time on the day: the most of your time first, then the most agent time, then by name. While calibrating, your time doesn't decide the order.

key.description: An opaque key, as in event.schema.json.

name.description: The project's display name from the local project map, or empty when the agent has none. It never leaves the device.

pending_s.description: The part of s in minutes still pending (DESIGN 3.7), which may change.

kinds.description: s by activity kind, the most first.

levels.description: s by evidence level, in the order A, B, C. Level C shows on the teen's own dashboard and never in public totals, build days or boards; a program counts it only if it opts in to level C (DESIGN 6.2 D5, D11).

share.description: The level's part of you.s in whole percent; a project's shares add up to 100.

name.description: The agent's name, such as Claude.

reason.description: SM 5.2's uncredited reasons, in its order, without X.agent_only and X.automated.

on_hold.description: Set on the part of X.noprog whose minutes are still pending or provisional, which progress can still bring back (SM 4.3, 5.1; approach-teen.md D5). The rest of X.noprog has an entry without it.
